I.text: The rewards accrual mechanism should be properly terminated via _endRewards()/endRewardsAccrual() when totalFeeShare reaches zero after graduation (unlocked = true)

V.evidence_quote: The issue occurs because the condition `if (totalFeeShare == 0 && !unlocked)` is incorrect.
